# Boredom Blaster

> A free, fast, neon space shooter that runs in any browser: five worlds, bosses, power-ups and a global
> high-score table protected by signed tickets. Plain JavaScript and HTML canvas, no engine, no accounts,
> no cookies. MIT licensed. Owner and author: Mauricio Alonso Moya Tapia.

- Play: https://maumoya.github.io/boredom-blaster-v2/
- How it is built: https://maumoya.github.io/boredom-blaster-v2/portfolio/

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/maumoya/boredom-blaster-v2/blob/main/README.md): what the game is, results, how it is built
- [Architecture](https://github.com/maumoya/boredom-blaster-v2/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): game loop, loader and the scores Worker
- [Security case](https://github.com/maumoya/boredom-blaster-v2/blob/main/docs/SECURITY_CASE.md): threats and the anti-cheat score checks
- [Changelog](https://github.com/maumoya/boredom-blaster-v2/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): releases and measured numbers
